mainEntity.name: What tools can help me test if my schema markup is correctly implemented?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary tool for testing schema markup is Google's Rich Results Test. This free tool allows you to input a URL or code snippet to check for valid schema and see which rich results are eligible. It identifies errors and warnings, helping you debug issues. Another useful resource is the Schema.org validator, which can verify the syntax of your structured data against the Schema.org vocabulary. These tools are essential for ensuring proper implementation and avoiding common mistakes.
